subject.title: fix(chat): prevent reasoning races after model changes

question: Must this PR show the Fable-to-Sol-to-Ultra sequence and immediate send against a live provider before merge, or should the existing cross-client E2E and lifecycle evidence receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: The implementation has extensive automated coverage, but repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for an external PR and the supplied live smoke does not exercise the changed behavior.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Request a redacted recording, transcript, or diagnostic log from the current head showing the model switch, Ultra selection, and immediate send succeed in order.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: Accept the automated cross-client evidence and signed lifecycle smoke as sufficient for this maintainer-directed change despite the missing live provider sequence.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted recording, transcript, or diagnostic log from the current head showing the model switch, Ultra selection, and immediate send succeed in order.

likelyOwner.reason: The work is described as maintainer-directed, and this person has the strongest recent history across the affected model-selection and native chat paths.
